name: When should a business consider implementing customer query research for GEO?

mainEntity.name: When should a business consider implementing customer query research for GEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: A business should consider implementing customer query research for GEO when they have a physical location, serve specific geographic areas, or aim to attract local customers. It is particularly beneficial for businesses expanding into new cities, experiencing local competition, or looking to improve their local search engine rankings. This research helps align online efforts with offline business goals.
acceptedAnswer.description: Businesses with physical locations or those targeting specific geographic areas should implement GEO customer query research to attract local customers.
